answer: Identity means a deposit you can lose. Auditors dip into the hollow of past answers and re-grade them at random; a confirmed cheat has its stake stripped, and proven fraud forfeits the whole escrow. A willow bends with every surprise audit — each forged identity needs its own funded stake and a record that stays clean forever, while the network grows like a fable retold: history keeps accumulating, so faking the past costs more than honest work pays.
